title: Iterated gate values
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers, let $a:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$, let $gs$ be a list of algebraic gates with $n$ inputs, and let $vs$ be a list of natural numbers. Define the evaluated list by processing the gates in order, appending to the current list the value of each gate computed modulo $k$ from $a$ and the current list, starting with $vs$.
hypotheses_covered: List $gs$ of algebraic gates with $n$ inputs
